resources.string: Tap “Start mic” and allow %1$s to use the microphone. The controls appear once you are connected to the PC.
Opening the microphone and connecting to the PC.
Adjust here or in the PC app; both always stay in sync.
Retrying. Check that the phone and PC are on the same Wi-Fi and LarmaMic is open.
Keep the phone screen on while in use.
The mic is only open while you hold the “Hold to talk” button at the bottom of the screen.
The background is loud or you just spoke. Try again in complete silence.
Could not measure. Audio must be streaming to the PC.
Level meter. Drag sideways to set the noise gate threshold.
The pairing code is wrong or was changed. Scan the QR code in the LarmaMic app again.
Safari is not allowed to use the microphone. Go to Settings > Safari > Microphone to enable it.
The browser is not allowed to use the microphone. Allow microphone access for this site in the browser settings.
The page must be opened over https://. Scan the QR code in the LarmaMic app.
Missing pairing code. Open the page by scanning the QR code in the LarmaMic app.
Could not turn the microphone back on. Tap “Start mic” to try again.
RNNoise is a neural network that separates your voice from fans, keyboards and street noise.
Cuts the background when you stop talking. Drag the white line on the meter to set the threshold.
set just above the background noise
removes wind, desk thumps and mains hum
Removes what the PC plays (the other side of a call) from the microphone, so they do not hear themselves. Needs the PC speakers or headphones as the default output.
Each slider ranges from −12 to +12 dB.
lower it if the voice sounds boomy
The clipping limiter is always on at −3 dB.
Keeps your voice even whether you sit near or far. Adjusts only while you speak.
evens out the voice; quiet parts don’t get lost
lower is faster but may glitch; on 5 GHz Wi-Fi use 40–80 ms
For fun or streaming. With everything off, your voice is unchanged.
negative: deeper, positive: higher (adds ~21 ms latency)
Tap to open. The microphone keeps working with the screen off.
Scan the QR code shown in LarmaMic on your PC
Microphone permission is needed to stream your voice.
Could not reach the PC. Check that both are on the same Wi-Fi and LarmaMic is open.
The PC’s security certificate changed. Scan the QR code again to trust it.
The phone and the PC must be on the same Wi-Fi.
Plug the cable into the PC, then either turn on USB debugging on the phone (detected automatically) or turn on USB tethering (Network > Hotspot and tethering). No Wi-Fi needed.
Pair the phone with the PC in Bluetooth settings, turn on Bluetooth tethering on the phone and join its network on the PC, then scan the QR code. Slower than Wi-Fi: audio is sent at 24 kHz.
Press a volume button to mute or unmute, even with the screen off. Takes effect the next time you start.
Searching for PCs on this network…
Waiting for you to allow this phone on “%1$s”…
The PC refused or did not answer in time.
Plays your processed voice back on this phone. Use headphones, otherwise you will get feedback. Not available over Bluetooth.
Scan the QR code first, or paste the address shown in LarmaMic.
